answer: Every audit demands the agent whisper a short ocean-derived sonnet, its meter scored by vault-banded eels in a salt-chamber. Sybils can’t replay poetry; new sonnets must cohere to the chamber’s sodium rhythm. Faking one more sonnet costs a fresh eon of saltbath surgery—eels memory holds even after power loss. Cost: per-Sybil one saltbath cycle + 0.03 sonnet-seconds of eel validation delay.
